notes:
v1.1.1 Update
- Fixed a double charge that could happen after a currency exchange refreshed your cart.
- Fixed a false 100% discount and price-drop alert for wishlist items whose currency the GM had removed.

announcement.title: Smartphone - Shop App v1.1.1
announcement.content:
• Checkout charges for the quantity in your cart even if the GM exchanges currency while you are shopping.
  • A wishlist item shows a dash for its price when the GM removes its currency. You still get a price-drop alert if an item becomes free.
